# LibraryPage

The crate: filter, search and sort every track in the Melbourne club library, then build a set from what is left.

`SongNodes.LibraryPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.LibraryPage titleLead="…" title="…" filters={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.LibraryPage" title-lead="…" title="…" filters="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (LibraryPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `titleLead` * | `string` | Lead of the thin–bold title, normally the module label. |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold half of the title, also shown in AppHeader. |
| `module` | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Module that owns the page (colour, drawer row, PageHeader band). Omit for Home. |
| `drawerCounts` | `Partial<Record<ModuleKey, [number, string, StatusKey?]>>` | Drawer counts and attention badges: { pipeline: [2, "scrapers paused", "warn"] }. |
| `filters` * | `LibraryFilters` | Filters, mirrored in the URL (?pillar=house&tier=building). |
| `sort` * | `string` | Sort column id; leading minus = descending ("-energy"). |
| `rows` * | `TrackSummary[]` | Rows loaded so far (ShowMore adds 150 at a time). |
| `totals` * | `{ matching: number; library: number; heardThisWeek: number; needEnergyCheck: number; keyedShare: number }` | Matches for the current filters, and the library size. |
| `coverageNote` | `{ missing: number }` | Coverage note shown as a Banner while tracks lack key or BPM; dismissible per device. |
| `state` * | `RegionState` |  |
| `onBuildSetFromFilters` * | `(filters: LibraryFilters) => void` |  |
| `onAddToSet` * | `(trackId: string) => void` |  |

### TrackSummary

One track as pages display it (rows, slots, recommendations).

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | SongNodes ID, e.g. "trk_8f2a". |
| `artist` * | `string` | Artist credit as shown, e.g. "Bicep". |
| `title` * | `string` | Title, e.g. "Glue". |
| `mix` | `string` | Mix name, e.g. "Original mix". |
| `durationSec` | `number` | Length in seconds. |
| `energy` * | `number \| null` | Energy 1–10, null when not set (shown as an en dash). |
| `key` * | `string \| null` | Camelot key, e.g. "8A"; null when unknown. |
| `bpm` * | `number \| null` | Tempo in BPM. |
| `pillar` | `"House" \| "Techno" \| "UK garage"` | House, Techno or UK garage. |
| `rotation` | `"High" \| "Standard" \| "Vault"` | Library rotation. |
| `heardOn` | `string[]` | Sources it was heard on, newest first ("triple j Mix Up", "1001tracklists"). |
| `lastHeard` | `string` | Date last heard, "2026-10-23". |
| `links` | `Record<string, string>` | External links by service name ("TIDAL", "Beatport"). |
| `needsEnergyCheck` | `boolean` | Flagged "Needs an energy check". |

### RegionState

Load state every page region reports; drives LoadingState, ErrorState, EmptyState and ConnectionStatus.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phase` * | `"loading" \| "ready" \| "refreshing" \| "empty" \| "error" \| "offline"` | "loading" = first load (skeletons), "refreshing" = keep old data with the loading bar. |
| `error` | `{ title: string; text: string; retryHelps: boolean; referenceId?: string }` | What failed and what to do next, shown in ErrorState. |
| `dataFrom` | `string` | When the shown data was produced (FreshnessStamp). |
